snippet.title: That was close! OPEN BETA OUT NOW
snippet.description:
Player the Stick and Stack open beta test here https://store.steampowered.com/app/3655080/Stick_and_Stack/
Give me a wishlist if you enjoyed it!
You can also play in the browser on itch here https://cammymoop.itch.io/stick-and-stack-beta/
Stick and Stack full release coming this month! Give it a try and let me know what you think :D

Music by Keestak
